Anya: rolling out q6b-int4 canary now — we need a quick plan for sampler bucketing + golden coverage. low risk but saw weird labeler disagreement last run :thinking_face:
Liam: where was the disagreement? long prompts or multimodal anchors?
Maya: it was mostly long-context customer support transcripts. labelers flagged ambiguous system prompts that change expected output style.
Jorge: ok. two vectors: (1) sampler needs longctx buckets so those examples land in a dedicated queue, (2) expand golden with 30-50 longctx anchors to reduce flakiness.
Anya: +1. can we do a microgolden refresh before the next weekday canary? we have 48h.
Liam: I can patch the sampler config now. quick config snippet: ```json
{
  "buckets": ["short:<128","mid:128-512","long:>512"],
  "long_priority_pct": 0.12,
  "label_queue": "longctx-annotate-v2"
}
```
Maya: label ops — will the new queue need different instructions? current guide assumes system prompt is stable.
LabelOpsBot: FYI — longctx-annotate-v2 created, estimated throughput 120 tasks/hr, target SLA 24h for canary priority.
Jorge: I'll assemble 40-long anchors from recent failures and synthetic paraphrases. I'll add explicit rubric examples showing when system prompt should be ignored vs followed.
Anya: thanks. also need a rollback trigger: if golden pass rate drops >6% or label disagreement >20% in 6h, auto-fallback to q6b-int8 and pause canary.
Liam: added fallback hook to the routing policy and pushed canary to staging. deploy-bot queued the rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: q6b-int4 -> staging. Observability alerts: latency and token-cost dashboards created. :shipit:
Maya: pairing schedule — I'll shadow labelers for the first 3h after canary. if anything ambiguous, annotate in thread with sample id.
Anya: perfect. owners: Liam (sampler + policy), Jorge (golden set), Maya (label ops), Anya (rollback + canary sign-off). update thread with any samples. :eyes:
